turns.q: Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
turns.replyTail:
Yes, sometimes, if the order has not shipped yet, a delivery address change may still be possible; once it has shipped, any changes usually depend on the carrier’s options.

If you already have tracking, the order has shipped, and the tracking page is the best place to check for reroute, hold, or delivery instruction options. If there’s no tracking yet, please share your order number and the corrected shipping address, including any unit number and ZIP code, so I can guide you on the next step.
